What's happening with IWM?

56m ago Powered by Yahoo Scout

IWM tracks the Russell 2000 Index, which represents U.S. small-cap stocks across healthcare, financials, technology, and other industries. Small-cap trading reflected a volatile macro backdrop, while IWM’s latest regular session plus after-hours move was down 0.18% on November 3. The fund had $78.0 billion in assets and a 0.98% distribution yield as of November 4.
